description: A dark, cobweb-filled corner of the attic. The air is stagnant and smells of mothballs. You can hear the faint scratching of something behind the walls.

wall.description: A wall covered in thick, sticky cobwebs.

floor.description: A floor covered in a thick layer of grey dust.

dusty_trunk.onInteract: You wipe decades of dust off an old leather shoe trunk, revealing catalogs of vintage high-heeled shoes from Shoeboxlandia's golden age.
dusty_trunk.description: An old leather shoe trunk tucked away in the corner.

hanging_mothball.onInteract: You inspect the hanging mothball. It's a giant, smelling of intense cedar and wood oils that makes your eyelets water.
hanging_mothball.description: A crystalline mothball hanging by a strand of spider silk.

item.name: Wild Potato
item.opened_description: A loose floorboard. Just a dark void of joists remains.
item.onCollect: You pry open the loose floorboard and discover a plump, slightly dusty Wild Potato hidden underneath!

loose_floorboard.description: A floorboard that seems slightly loose and uneven.

exit_east.description: The shelf continues east back toward the shoe rack.

exit_south.description: A small hole leads down to the bedroom.

item_chest.description: An old, locked jewelry box (sized for a shoe).

item.onCollect: Your piercing scream vibrates the lock until it pops open! Inside is a shiny silver eyelet.
